title: Float-Down Option Terms of the Rate Lock Commitment Products
content:
Some **Rate Lock Commitment** products include a one-time float-down option. The table states, for each product, whether the option is offered and on what terms.

| Rate Lock Commitment product | Float-down option included | Minimum rate improvement (percent) | Float-down fee (points) | Float-downs allowed per lock | Refused once the initial Closing Disclosure is issued | Expiration date left unchanged |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur 15-Day Rate Lock | No | 0.250 | 0.000 | 0 | Yes | Yes |
| Larkspur 30-Day Rate Lock | No | 0.250 | 0.000 | 0 | Yes | Yes |
| Larkspur 45-Day Rate Lock | Yes | 0.250 | 0.250 | 1 | Yes | Yes |
| Larkspur 60-Day Rate Lock | Yes | 0.250 | 0.250 | 1 | Yes | Yes |
| Larkspur 90-Day Rate Lock | Yes | 0.250 | 0.375 | 1 | Yes | Yes |
| Larkspur 120-Day Extended Rate Lock | Yes | 0.250 | 0.500 | 1 | Yes | Yes |
| Larkspur 180-Day New Construction Rate Lock | Yes | 0.250 | 0.500 | 1 | Yes | Yes |

**Column meanings**

- **Minimum rate improvement**: the smallest drop, in percent to 3 decimals, of the current rate-sheet rate below the locked rate, at the same price, that allows the float-down to be exercised.
- **Float-down fee**: the fee, in points to 3 decimals, to exercise the float-down. It is 0.000 where the option is not offered.
- **Float-downs allowed**: the number allowed per lock. It is 0 where the option is not offered.
- **Refused once the initial Closing Disclosure is issued**: the float-down is refused after the initial Closing Disclosure has been issued.
- **Expiration date left unchanged**: a float-down does not move the lock expiration date.

### Notes

- The Larkspur 15-Day Rate Lock and the Larkspur 30-Day Rate Lock carry no float-down option. Their fee is 0.000 and they allow 0 float-downs.
- *Hypothetical illustration:* with a locked rate of 6.875% on a product that offers the option, a current rate-sheet rate of 6.625% at the same price is 0.250 below the locked rate, which meets the 0.250 minimum. A current rate of 6.750% is only 0.125 below and does not meet it.
